orchestration_semantics.atomic_action: One behavior entry using an action from catalog.actions.
orchestration_semantics.composite_action: A scenario-level behavior graph made by combining atomic actions across one or more actors.
orchestration_semantics.stage_name: The label of a behavior node. Multiple actors may intentionally share a label so one trigger fans out to all of them.
orchestration_semantics.trigger: A directed transition emitted after a behavior. A nonempty trigger must equal at least one behavior stage_name; an empty trigger emits no transition.
orchestration_semantics.target: For Attack and MoveToTarget, the target must identify an existing dynamic actor by actor object key or PawnIdentifier.
orchestration_semantics.cycles: Trigger cycles are supported for repeating behavior chains.
orchestration_semantics.composition_rule: Do not require a real-world scenario phrase to be an action name. Decompose it into supported atomic actions, actor targets, stage labels, and trigger transitions.

fixture_patterns.composition: Multiple GenericHumanAICharacter civilians loiter, optionally with PCG_ped_crowd_1.
Unique PawnIdentifier values identify actors. Trigger values reference stage_name labels across actors, and cycles can repeat the chain.
Supports Sequential, immediate, A, and B tracks plus triggers and multiple actors.
A GenericHumanAICharacter wanders in woods with optional trees and grass.
A leader moves between points and a follower targets the leader PawnIdentifier.
Uses Car_model1, Pedestrian_Model, Drone_Helper, and PCG_ped_crowd_1.

A shooter uses Attack with trigger shots_fired_stage. Civilian and receiver behaviors labeled stage_name shots_fired_stage fan out in response, then may emit further triggers such as victim_flee. The shooter may move or flee. Many pedestrians can use explicit civilians or PCG_ped_crowd_1. This scenario is supported.
Uses BP_BuoyancyDrowner as a supported dynamic actor.

intents: search for missing person in woods
fixture_patterns.composition: Uses BP_MissingAICharacter with optional trees and grass.
PlayAnimation uses AS_AimAndShoot.
MoveToTarget and Attack target a valid PawnIdentifier.
A behavior trigger names another behavior stage_name.
Attack produces a shots-fired trigger and civilians or receivers move in response.
AttachToHand uses the configured SM_Pistol transform, followed by DetachFromHand.
An actor waits and then destroys itself while another actor may witness it.
Idle waits for duration seconds.
Loiter moves randomly using an allowed radius parameter.
Set speed, move to an x,y,z location, then optionally destroy the actor.

intents: switch between order A and B
fixture_patterns.composition: Behaviors use order A and B tracks, with a trigger switching stages.

intents: procedural trees grass fire buildings or crowd
fixture_patterns.composition: Procedural actors use PCG_tree_default, PCG_grass_default, PCG_fire_test, PCG_building_default, or PCG_ped_crowd_1 with density and Seed.

Loiter.description: Move randomly within the radius in parameters.

MoveToLocation.description: Move to the x,y,z location string.

MoveToTarget.description: Move toward the actor named by target.

Attack.description: Attack the actor named by target.

PlayAnimation.description: Play the animation named in parameters.

AttachToHand.description: Attach the selected asset using its transform parameters.

Flee.description: Flee toward an extraction point or map edge.
